sources.title: SinLlama - A Large Language Model for Sinhala - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract Low-resource languages such as Sinhala are often overlooked by open-source Large Language Models (LLMs). Therefore, it is imperative that the existing LLMs are further trained to cover such languages.
